'''Bregor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the rank of the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]], he recruited an Imperial hero to ransack a supply cache being used by [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] rebel forces and to defeat the [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]] guarding it.
